title: HHHusher bento (v2)
description: Three dark 5px-cornered media cards on a bronze-tan band: one tall card filling the left 60%, two shorter ones stacked on the right (all stacked on phones). Each has a title, a short paragraph and a yellow caps read-more link at the top left over a full-bleed film; the text fades in as the card comes up the window.
notes: the band is the secondary colour; the cards force dark
one media slot per card (video or picture), cropped like cover
follows the overview slider on the same band (no top padding of its own by default)
name: hhhusher-v2-bento
